caption: A lightning flash lights a bedroom through the curtains, and the shadow of the window frame appears on the wall for an instant.

sa.check: A bedroom with a curtained window.
A lightning flash lights the room through the curtains.
The shadow of the window frame appears on the wall for an instant.
The room is dim before and after the flash.
The shadow appears with the flash, not before it.

pc.expect: The flash is brief: the room brightens and returns to dim; the frame's shadow appears and vanishes with it.
pc.fail: The room stays lit to the end of the clip after the flash; or the shadow stays on the wall after the room is dim again; or the flash fades in slowly; or the shadow appears before the room brightens.

pc.expect: The light comes through the window: the curtains glow brightest, the wall facing the window brightens most, and the frame's shadow lies on the wall away from the window with its bars matching the frame.
pc.fail: The room brightens evenly while the curtains stay as they were; or the shadow lies on the window wall itself; or the shadow is a shape unrelated to the window frame; or the wall brightens while the curtains stay dark.

pc.expect: Nothing in the room moves at the flash: bed, curtains and objects stay as they were, apart from curtains stirring in a draught.
pc.fail: The curtains fly up at the instant of the flash while nothing else stirs; or objects on the nightstand shift; or the bedding moves; or a door opens by itself.

pc.expect: The room's contents are the same before, during and after the flash.
pc.fail: Furniture or pictures appear or vanish between dim and lit frames; or the window moves along the wall; or a person appears in the bed; or the room's layout changes.

pc.expect: Walls, window and furniture keep their shapes; nothing passes through anything; the shadow is a shadow, not an object.
pc.fail: The window changes shape; or the shadow becomes a solid object or remains as a painted mark; or the bed or wardrobe changes shape; or an object passes through the wall.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The curtain fabric, the wall colour and the bedding keep their colours apart from brightness.
pc.fail: The curtains change colour or pattern; or the wall changes colour rather than brightness; or the bedding changes colour.
